scope: Every phase 2 case below prompt version 7 (327 of 584). The 257 v7 cases are flows and belong to #54. A case counts only when a check_phase2.py --language rust run passed on the product the current binary compiles and assembles (same rust.files_sha256); RS12 and RS13 count when the run gave the inventory refusal.

behavior.method: collect53.py compiled and assembled each case on a dev server of the binary above (port 18955, dev-h-verify-004) and took the latest Rust run with the same product.

other_runs.cap-g-003: Stopped partway (9 case files, one empty). Two cases, compositions120-0003 and compositions120-0061, failed there on their current product when cargo exited 101 during dependency compilation with no compile error in the log; both passed on the same product in cap-g-004.
other_runs.cap-g-004: 44 run, 26 passed: the 18 failures are v7 cases whose ids matched the selection and were refused with UNSUPPORTED_TARGET at the time; v7 is #54.

phase1_products.note: All 115 phase 1 products are byte-identical to the b-gates-001 products.

product_checks.som_targets: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy -D warnings and cargo test (18 passed) on som-rs/som-targets at 20fc0076da, run before that commit. The mod.rs test renders 17 capability prompts, including v5 with capability_mongodb.
not_run: check_rust_products.py product_gates over the phase 2 inventory (#55)

phase1_plan_now.note: The phase 1 A6 (v6 prompt on the v5 base) and A8 (Title rename) refusals no longer hold, because phase 2 admits both prompts; phase 2 replaces them as CONTRACT.md says.

python_behavior_baseline.note: Python defects RS07, RS14, RS16 and refusals RS12, RS13; #57.

decisions.timestamps: Rust read models print timestamps as pydantic does: six fraction digits and Z for UTC. The Python fixture run behavior-python-004 used the host zone Asia/Taipei (+08:00); behavior-python-utc-001 (TZ=UTC, 5 cases, 5 passed) prints the same Z form as Rust, so the offset difference comes from the environment, not the product. Rust runs use a UTC cluster.

known_differences: 422 bodies omit pydantic input and ctx members.
Some Python 500 responses are 401 or 503 in Rust.
rediss:// is not supported; of the Redis URL query options only db is read.
GCS application default credentials resolve lazily: service_account and authorized_user files and the metadata server, not CLOUDSDK_CONFIG.
Firebase production verifies through the securetoken JWKS URL, not the x509 cert endpoint.
README line widths differ from the Python README.
v5 with capability_mongodb has no behavior case in the inventory; it is covered by the som-targets unit test and compile checks only.
